subject.title: refactor(channels): move inbound turn execution into core

question: Should the optional public `configOverride` parameter remain a supported Plugin SDK dispatch contract, or should the Teams timezone case be solved through a narrower owner-private seam?
rationale: The field is additive and appears intended to preserve existing Teams behavior, but exposing it in dispatcher types makes a new long-lived plugin-facing compatibility surface that cannot be safely selected by automated review.

options.title: Accept the resolver-only SDK field
options.body: Keep the additive parameter, document its resolver-only boundary in review evidence, and retain focused forwarding coverage after rebase.

options.title: Keep the override internal
options.body: Replace the public parameter with a Teams- or core-owned internal seam if maintainers do not want this configuration patch exposed to plugin consumers.

recommendation.title: Accept the resolver-only SDK field
recommendation.body: Keep the additive parameter, document its resolver-only boundary in review evidence, and retain focused forwarding coverage after rebase.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged predecessor and this follow-up branch establish the channel-turn ownership design and introduce the disputed dispatch contract.
